decision: Drive through penalty. (20 seconds added to elapsed Sprint time).
offence: Breach of Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty. (20 seconds added to elapsed Sprint time).
reason: Car 44 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this event by 10.7 km/h. Per the Penalty Guidelines, the penalty for speeding in the pit lane during a sprint session race by between 6-15km/h is a drive through. This is what we impose. As the drive through penalty was imposed during the last three laps, it will be converted to a 20 second time penalty per Article 54.3 (d) of the Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 44 Pit Lane Speeding
